dedupe_keys.name: data rivm nl drinking water datasets

description: data.rivm.nl: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.rivm.nl. Coverage: the area served by data.rivm.nl. The listing groups 22 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: DANK -Gebruik en behoefte aan zoetwater voor diverse functies: Locatie; Openbare drinkwaterkranen; Drinkwaterwinlokaties waar nitraat is aangemerkt als (potentiële) prob; Kwaliteit van drinkwater in Nederland (2012) (WMS). Formats seen: WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
